en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the one with sexual impurity eating and drinking and reciting (the Quran)’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, he can eat and drink and recite (the Quran), and mentioned Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic whatever he so desires to’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from ibn Bukayr who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of one who after sexual relation eats, drinks or reads. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, one can eat, drink, read and speak of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, as much as one likes.’”
